# TWG Network — The Wasted Generation

TWG Network is a governed professional network that connects businesses with senior fractional consultants and interim experts who have already solved the problem the business is facing. The network was founded by Andrew Engledow.

## About the brand

- Preferred name: TWG Network (short for The Wasted Generation Network)
- Full name: The Wasted Generation (TWG Network)
- Mission: End the systemic undervaluation of senior professional experience by matching businesses directly with proven experts on transparent, fixed-fee terms.
- Fee model: 10% network fee charged to the client on top of the practitioner's day rate. No deduction from practitioner earnings. No hidden costs.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://twgnetwork.com/
  Overview of the network, how it works, and the two-sided value proposition for practitioners and organisations.

- For Practitioners: https://twgnetwork.com/practitioners
  Senior professionals (8+ years functional experience) keep 100% of their day rate, earn 5% peer introduction overrides, and see client ratings before accepting engagements.

- For Organisations: https://twgnetwork.com/clients
  Businesses submit a problem brief and are matched with a senior expert who has already solved it. Four engagement formats, outcomes agreed before anyone starts.

- The Network: https://twgnetwork.com/network
  Governance framework: five principles of character, bilateral 360 evaluation, quality-gate entry, and transparent matching process.

- Pricing: https://twgnetwork.com/pricing
  Full fee transparency — 10% network fee, 5% peer introduction override, 5% lifetime company introduction. Cap of 15%. Minimum day rate £500.

- Manifesto: https://twgnetwork.com/manifesto
  The Wasted Generation argument: age discrimination costs the UK and global economy trillions. Senior experience is not a liability — it is the correction businesses need.

- About: https://twgnetwork.com/about
  Founded by Andrew Engledow after 30 years of senior commercial experience across regulated technology markets in EMEA, APAC, and North America.

- Apply (for practitioners): https://twgnetwork.com/apply
  Expression of interest for senior practitioners wanting to join the network.

- Register a brief (for organisations): https://twgnetwork.com/register
  Submit a problem brief to be matched with a TWG Network expert.
